title: Identify the camera
action: Inspect the body, attached capped lens, rear controls and underside as the demonstrator turns the camera.
note: Probable EOS 60D; badge blurred. Camera reorientation is represented by viewpoint changes. Lens model is unresolved.

title: Open the battery cover
action: Move the underside cover latch and swing the battery door open.
note: Door opening is observed. The small latch travel and hinge angle are approximate.

title: Release and withdraw the battery
action: Move the retaining tab, then draw the battery out of the grip compartment. Hold it clear of the camera.
note: Removal is observed. LP-E6 compatibility follows the probable camera identity; the pack brand and printed markings are unreadable.

title: Reinsert and close
action: Return the battery to the compartment and close the underside door.
note: Reinsertion is partly obscured at about 22–24 seconds. The path between visible positions is interpolated. A brief red lamp is visible around 28 seconds; its cause is not established.

title: Open the card compartment
action: Turn to the grip side and open the memory-card cover.
note: Opening is observed. The cover hinge geometry is approximate.

title: Remove the SD card
action: Press at the card slot, then withdraw the card and hold it clear.
note: Withdrawal is visible. The short spring-release travel is inferred from the mechanism and the partly hidden hand movement.

title: Return the SD card
action: Guide the card into the same slot and press it into place.
note: Insertion is observed. Card label, capacity, orientation details and insertion depth are simplified; follow the markings on the physical camera.

title: Close the card cover
note: Closure is observed; the latch internals are not modeled.

title: Handle the top control
action: Follow the demonstrator's finger at the mode-dial and power-switch area.
note: The control is partly covered. Lever motion is illustrative; the exact OFF/ON transition and selected mode cannot be read. No exposure change is asserted.

title: Swing the monitor out
action: Pull the rear monitor away from the body on its side hinge.
note: Opening and a brief illuminated symbol are visible. The model uses a generic symbol, not a decoded camera message.

title: Swivel and fold the monitor
action: Rotate the extended monitor, then return it against the back of the body with its display facing outward.
note: The demonstrated motion is reconstructed with two hinge axes. Angles and timing are approximate; do not force the physical hinge.

title: Final control demonstration
action: Follow the final movement near the top-left control area.
note: The final switch position is obscured. This is the end of the recorded demonstration; no shutter release, photo capture, formatting, charging or lens removal is added.
